get.summary:
Lists organizations the authenticated user is an active member of.
Soft-deleted orgs are excluded, and membership scoping avoids leaking org existence across tenants.
The response uses only public `OrgResponse` fields.

post.summary:
Creates a new organization for the authenticated user and returns an `OrgResponse`.
On success, the creator is enrolled as an active member and granted the `owner` role.
The slug is normalized and collision-resolved on insert; creator name conflicts return `409`.
The response intentionally omits membership state and roles.

409.description: Organization with this name already exists for this user.

get.summary:
Fetches organization details by slug for the authenticated caller.
Returns `404` for non-members or inactive memberships to reduce cross-tenant enumeration.
Converts `OrgContext` to `OrgResponse`, excluding roles and membership status.

delete.summary:
Soft-deletes one owner-authorized tenant after locking current membership and ancestry.
Immediate active children must be empty; no recursive deletion occurs.
Inaccessible and repeated targets return 404 without disclosing tenant information.
A valid session needing recent authentication receives the stable reauthentication error code.
An optional expected UUID restricts deletion to the originally confirmed organization.

parameters.name: X-Permesi-Expected-Organization-Id
parameters.description: Optional UUID pin from the confirmed capabilities response. A different organization returns 404.

400.description: Malformed or repeated expected organization UUID header.

401.description: Full authenticated session required; stale authentication returns reauthentication_required.

patch.summary:
Updates an organization's name and/or slug and returns the updated `OrgResponse`.
Requires `OrgContext::can_manage`; otherwise it returns `404` to avoid leaking org existence.
The slug is normalized and uniqueness conflicts map to `409`, and roles are never returned.

get.summary:
Returns only server-derived owner/admin eligibility for an active tenant member.
Inaccessible tenants return 404; all outcomes prohibit caching stale authority hints.

200.description: Current role eligibility; not mutation authorization. Cache-Control: no-store.

get.summary:
Lists active (non-deleted) projects for an organization as `ProjectResponse` DTOs.
Only active org members can list; non-members receive `404` to avoid tenant leakage.
The response returns only project fields, not nested org membership or roles.

post.summary:
Creates a project under an organization and returns a `ProjectResponse`.
Callers must pass `OrgContext::can_manage`; unauthorized callers receive `404` to avoid leaking existence.
The slug is normalized and uniqueness violations are mapped to `409`.
The response omits any org membership or role information.

delete.summary:
Soft-deletes one owner/admin-authorized resource after locking current membership and ancestry.
Immediate active children must be empty; no recursive deletion occurs.
Inaccessible and repeated targets return 404 without disclosing tenant information.

get.summary:
Lists active (non-deleted) environments for a project as `EnvironmentResponse` DTOs.
Requires org membership and hides project existence from non-members via `404`.
The response returns only environment fields, not project/org membership details.

post.summary:
Creates an environment within a project and returns an `EnvironmentResponse`.
Requires `OrgContext::can_manage`; unauthorized callers receive `404` to avoid leaking existence.
Either tier may be created first; the database enforces at most one active production per project.
The response includes only environment DTO fields.

delete.summary:
Soft-deletes one owner/admin-authorized resource after locking current membership and ancestry.
Immediate active children must be empty; no recursive deletion occurs.
Inaccessible and repeated targets return 404 without disclosing tenant information.

get.summary:
Lists active (non-deleted) applications for an environment as `ApplicationResponse` DTOs.
Returns `404` when the org/project/env cannot be resolved for the current principal.
The response returns only app fields, not environment or org membership data.

404.description: Organization, project, or environment not found.

post.summary:
Creates an application within an environment and returns an `ApplicationResponse`.
Requires `OrgContext::can_manage` and returns `404` when the org/project/env is inaccessible.
The response includes only app fields, not environment or membership details.

404.description: Organization, project, or environment not found.

delete.summary:
Soft-deletes one owner/admin-authorized resource after locking current membership and ancestry.
Immediate OAuth clients must be explicitly deleted; no recursive deletion occurs.
Inaccessible and repeated targets return 404 without disclosing tenant information.

client_id.description: Public identifier used in management paths and future protocol requests.

ClientType.description: Whether a deployment can protect credentials; this does not enable any grant type.

ConsentInput.description: Consent form accepts only a stored request, CSRF capability and binary decision.

tier.description:
Classification only: either tier may be created first. Defaults to non-production.
A project allows at most one active production environment.

name.description:
Case-sensitive OAuth token in resource:action format (for example jobs:read).
Exactly one colon and two nonempty parts are required; protocol/internal names are reserved.

CreateSecretRequest.description: Explicit empty creation body; unknown fields cannot alter hashing/lifecycle policy.

Discovery.description: Metadata advertises only implemented code/token behavior and public key location.

tier.description: Security/operational classification, independent of the environment's name or slug.

EnvironmentTier.description:
Classifies sibling environments directly owned by a project, without creation prerequisites.
Each project permits zero or one active production environment and many non-production ones.

ErrorBody.description: Stable error code plus a human-readable message.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; safe to show to the caller.

IssuedSecretResponse.description: Sole plaintext-bearing DTO; returned once by successful create/rotate with no-store.

Jwk.description: RSA verification key encoded using unsigned big-endian base64url integers.

Jwks.description: Public-only JSON Web Key Set; every retained Vault version is independently identifiable.

MfaRecoveryRequest.description: Payload for verifying an MFA recovery code during challenge.

email.description: Compatibility field; authority comes from the server-bound exchange identity.

login_id.description: Unguessable single-attempt reference; only its hash is stored in shared PostgreSQL.

OrgCapabilities.description:
Current member's role eligibility, never proof of authority for a mutation.
Emptiness and recent authentication are checked separately at deletion time.

RotateSecretRequest.description: Optimistic concurrency binding to the credential the manager actually reviewed.

kind.description: "protocol" entries have server-defined semantics and are read-only.

name.description: Original OAuth token; application resource/action semantics are derived, never duplicated.

SecretResponse.description: Current or retiring metadata, never a credential hash or recoverable secret.

SessionKind.description: Session kinds used to gate MFA bootstrap and challenge flows.

TokenFailure.description: OAuth error envelope deliberately excludes submitted values and diagnostic text.

TokenResponse.description: Successful protocol response. Secrets have no Debug and serialize only at the wire boundary.

TokenSecurityMetadata.description: Implemented client authentication and issuer identification capabilities.
